basis: Wolfspeed’s fiscal Q2 2025 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated GAAP statement reports net revenue of $180.5 million for the three months ended December 29, 2024, versus $208.4 million for the three months ended December 31, 2023. Revenue declined 13.39%, below the $197.98 million ceiling. The November guidance still allowed revenue of $200 million, and the intervening disclosures reviewed did not lower that upper bound.

coverage.detail: January 31, 2024. The prior-year Q2 release reported $208.4 million of consolidated revenue from continuing operations and disclosed the sale of the RF business to MACOM. The fiscal Q2 2025 release carries forward that same $208.4 million comparative and presents discontinued operations separately.
August 21, 2024. The fiscal Q4 2024 release forecast $185 million to $215 million of revenue from continuing operations for fiscal Q1 2025. Its quarterly forecast covered the September quarter.

October 15, 2024. The funding announcement and related management update discussed CHIPS funding, financing and production capacity. The approximately $3 billion revenue target discussed on the call was annual revenue at full utilization.

November 6, 2024. The fiscal Q1 release explicitly forecast $160 million to $200 million of continuing-operations revenue for fiscal Q2. The high end exceeded the $197.98 million ceiling by $2.02 million and allowed a year-over-year decline of only 4.03%.
The November earnings presentation repeated the $160 million to $200 million Q2 range. Its separate $50 million to $70 million estimate covered only the Mohawk Valley facility’s contribution.
November 18, 2024. The CEO transition release discussed a goal of consistent sales growth and gave no numerical December-quarter revenue update.

Wolfspeed announced CFO Neill Reynolds’s December 3 public UBS fireside chat. His remarks addressed EV demand, design wins, financing and capital spending without giving a revised consolidated Q2 revenue range. [Transcript of the CFO’s remarks](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/wolf/transcripts/265239-ubs-global-technology-and-ai-conference/)
December 9, 2024. The $200 million maximum in this 8-K was the aggregate sale price of common stock under an equity distribution agreement.
January 15, 2025. Wolfspeed announced completion of the $200 million equity offering and a CHIPS funding milestone. The release gave no preliminary Q2 revenue figure.

January 29, 2025. The earnings highlights rounded Q2 revenue to $181 million. The consolidated statement’s quarterly net revenue row gives the more precise $180.5 million. The release’s forward range of $170 million to $200 million applies to fiscal Q3.

publication_date_evidence: Wolfspeed dated the Q2 release January 29, 2025 and stated that it announced the results that day. EDGAR accepted the Form 8-K carrying the release as Exhibit 99.1 on January 29 at 16:07:06 ET.
